# STUDS

> STUDS (Support Through United Dad Strength) is a group of Singapore men who train together and take on endurance races to raise money for a different charity each year. Formed in Singapore in 2025. Website: https://studs-sg.netlify.app/ (about the group: https://studs-sg.netlify.app/about.html)

## Season 2 (2026)

- Challenges: Laguna Phuket Triathlon and IRONMAN 70.3 Western Australia in Busselton, Australia, on 6 December 2026
- Cause: Lao Friends Hospital for Children in Luang Prabang, Laos. Friends Without A Border runs the hospital and organises the fundraiser.
- Target: S$150,000 to S$200,000
- Raised so far: US$115,000 on GoFundMe as at 9 November 2026 (GoFundMe goal US$100,000)
- Donate: [GoFundMe](https://www.gofundme.com/f/studs-season-2-bigger-bolder-and-back-for-more). Donations go to Friends Without A Border; GoFundMe shows the latest total.

## About the hospital

- Free care for children in northern Laos since 2015, with Lao doctors and nurses trained on site
- 38,000 children seen each year
- 24 neonatal beds, the only unit of its kind in the region
- 1 in 34 children in Laos die before turning five (UNICEF)
- More: [Friends Without A Border](https://fwab.org/about-the-hospital)

## Season 1 (2025)

- Raised US$114,454 (about S$150,000) for Caring for Cambodia, against a S$20,000 target
- 22 STUDS members raced the Laguna Phuket Triathlon on 23 November 2025

## The group

- More than 35 members racing triathlons, OCEANMAN swims, running races and cycling events
- STUDS is not a registered charity. Each year the group votes on a charity, and donations go straight to it.
- Sponsors: Boomarang Bistro & Bar (https://www.boomarang.com.sg/) and Tsunami (https://www.tsunami-sport.com/)
- Motto: outrun the drinkers, outdrink the runners, and look after each other’s physical and mental wellbeing
- Sponsorship: the sponsorship button on https://studs-sg.netlify.app/about.html opens a WhatsApp message to the group
